snapshots.commit_message: Packaged more error information into wasm and into the playground.
removed aspen check flags for things to skip since it doesn't make sense when we added semantic checking. Reporting syntax errors improved.
Added vb6semantic playground system for analyzer, symbol table, etc.
First pass in creating VBType, Value, ArrayValue, and VBError structs for the runtime system
Knocked out a large number of string runtime functions
